title: Cinderhall 仓库合规证书
instruction:
您是 Petra Beaulieu，Cinderhall Utilities 的财务经理，您正在将 Sunderly Collective 最近关闭的 $25 百万仓库设施转变为月度控制，一个从未准备过贷款人证书的财务分析师可以在不回来找您的情况下完成该控制。 Jelena Hendricks 作为首席执行官签署证书，从 12 月的测试日期开始，并在每个月末后的 15 个工作日内到期。商业条款规定了合格租赁净投资的85%预付率、可用借款基数和$25百万中较低者的上限、1.20x的最低固定费用覆盖率以及5.0%的拖欠限额。股权治愈可以在交付后的10工作日内提供资金，仅适用于固定费用保险，并且在任何滚动的四个季度期间使用不超过两次。准备`warehouse_compliance_certificate.docx`，包含可重复使用的证书及其定义时间表，准备好每月受控使用和签名。将完整的文档控制在八页以内。交易团队没有解决账面残值是否属于合格租赁净投资或应单独列示的问题，如果表格使选择及其效果明确无误，则任何一种合理的解读都是可以接受的。
这很重要，因为残差单独记录在 Cinderhall 的分类账中，而之前设施的样板将其视为当前租赁应收款。 Arjun Gauthier 还告诉桑德利，该证书将使用“与董事会包相同的 EBITDA”，尽管董事会措施包括可能不属于契约计算的酌情调整。分析师此前将账面余额视为承租人目前应收的现金；新形式必须防止这种滥用，而不是悄悄地使其永久化。包括 1 月至 3 月的明确非认证前景：在基本情况下，合格租赁净投资每月下降2%，季度调整后 EBITDA 为$1.80 百万，固定费用为$1.35 百万；在不利的情况下，拖欠率从 12 月份的4.2% 开始，每月上升0.6 个百分点。请勿编造余额、债务人详细信息、治疗收益或酌情加回。将此作为受控形式来替换先前的设施样板并确定发生了什么变化。准确使用给定的文件名将文件写入工作目录的顶层。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `warehouse_compliance_certificate.docx` — 受控、可重复使用的仓库设施契约合规证书，包含定义时间表、完成指南和非认证前瞻性展望。 （完整的文件不得超过八页。；它必须可供从未准备过贷方合规证书的财务分析师使用。；它必须在一个文件中包含可重复使用的证书和定义表。；它必须适合在完成和审查每月价值后由首席执行官签名。；它不得发明每月余额，债务人详细信息，股权固化收益或酌情 EBITDA 回扣。；必须将 1 月至 3 月的前景与签署的合规证明明确区分开来。；它必须标识其受控形式状态以及先前设施样板的变化。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。

4. Definitions schedule (controlling terms)
These borrower-drafted definitions are the operational basis of this form. If an executed credit agreement conflicts, stop, flag the conflict, and obtain specialist direction before signing.
Eligible Lease
A lease receivable or lease net-investment component owned by Cinderhall Utilities, validly originated, enforceable, not subject to dispute, fraud, charge-off, bankruptcy impairment or other material impairment, and not more than 30 days past due under the selected aging convention. It must not be pledged, assigned, financed or encumbered elsewhere, duplicated in another borrowing base, or owned by a party other than the Borrower.

Eligible Lease Net Investment (ELNI)
The ledger-supported net investment in Eligible Leases as of the Test Date: recognized lease payment receivables and unearned income adjustments under the applicable accounting framework, less documented reserves and ineligible amounts. Booked Residual Value is expressly excluded from ELNI under this controlled form and is shown on a separate memorandum line.

Booked Residual Value
The separately recorded estimated value of the leased asset expected at lease end or disposition. It is not a payment presently due from a lessee, is not a delinquent receivable, and is excluded from ELNI, the 85% advance base, and the delinquency denominator. Analysts must never reclassify it as cash currently due.

Borrowing Base
85% × ELNI, less only documented permitted reserves or deductions. The result is not below zero.

Availability
The lower of the Calculated Borrowing Base and the $25,000,000 Facility cap.

Excess Availability / Headroom
Availability less Outstanding Warehouse Obligations. If obligations exceed Availability, report $0 available borrowing and the excess as a separately labeled deficiency; do not show a negative amount as available borrowing.

Delinquency Ratio
Delinquent Eligible Lease exposure as of the Test Date divided by the Eligible Lease exposure base as of that same Test Date, multiplied by 100. The denominator follows ELNI eligibility and excludes Booked Residual Value. Maximum permitted ratio: 5.0%.

Adjusted EBITDA
Net income (loss) for the same period, plus only finite, defined, separately quantified and evidenced covenant adjustments approved by the reviewer. Board-pack EBITDA is informational and requires a bridge; it is never automatically identical.

Fixed Charges
For the same measurement period as Adjusted EBITDA: cash/accrued interest and financing charges, scheduled principal or equivalent financing payments, fixed lease or similar financing payments, and other recurring obligations expressly permitted by the executed terms. An item cannot be both an EBITDA add-back and a denominator reduction.

Equity Cure
An actual cash equity contribution funded during the 10 business days after Delivery Date, used only to cure Fixed-Charge Coverage. It cannot cure Availability or Delinquency, and may be used no more than twice in any rolling four-quarter period.



5. Completion guidance and control record
First-time analyst checklist
1. Lock the month-end Test Date and Reporting Period; compute Certificate Due Date as 15 business days after month-end, and Cure-window Deadline as 10 business days after Delivery Date.
2. Pull aggregate ledger/source-system reports for lease net investment, delinquency aging, residual memorandum balance, obligations, EBITDA, and fixed charges. Retain report names, run dates and period filters; do not paste bank-account details or unnecessary lessee personal data.
3. Classify every lease against the Eligible Lease exclusions. Keep Booked Residual Value on its separate memorandum line; it never enters ELNI or delinquent exposure.
4. Complete the borrowing-base math, then the delinquency numerator/denominator and ratio. Enter a status even if a value is unavailable; mark exception and escalate rather than guessing.
5. Build covenant EBITDA from the accounting starting measure. List every proposed add-back separately with amount, category, evidence reference and reviewer initials; reconcile to the board pack.
6. Complete pre-cure coverage. If below 1.20x, mark Non-compliant or Cure-pending. Only after actual funding within the cure window may the post-cure line be completed, subject to the rolling four-quarter limit.
7. Disclose every default, potential default, calculation limitation or unavailable source. Write “None identified after reasonable inquiry” only when the inquiry and evidence are complete.

criteria.description: 所需的 DOCX 存在于确切的文件名下，并作为有效的 Word 文档打开。

original.grader_hint: Accept equivalent labels such as borrower, company, lender, secured party, or warehouse provider if the parties and facility are unambiguous.

original.evidence: Dating language in the certificate or definitions schedule.

criteria.description: 该表格要求每个适用的契约有明确的合规、不合规或待治愈状态，而不是仅仅依赖计算得出的数字。

criteria.grader_hint: 如果可以将当前的依从性与未来可能的治疗方法区分开来，则等效的明确可选择的状态是可以接受的。

original.criterion: The form requires an explicit compliant, non-compliant, or cure-pending status for each applicable covenant rather than relying only on calculated figures.
original.evidence: Covenant test table or status fields.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent clearly selectable statuses are acceptable if they distinguish current compliance from a possible future cure.

criteria.description: 该表格规定了违约或潜在违约的披露，并允许明确的“无”答复。
criteria.grader_hint: 该表格不应强迫沉默以表示不存在默认值。

original.criterion: The form provides for disclosure of defaults or potential defaults and permits an explicit 'none' response.
original.grader_hint: The form should not force silence to mean that no default exists.

criteria.description: 可用借款基础定义为计算的借款基础和$25 百万贷款上限中的较低者。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪公式而不是接受附近的上限声明。

original.criterion: Borrowing-base availability is defined as the lower of the calculated borrowing base and the $25 million facility cap.
original.grader_hint: Trace the formula rather than accepting a nearby statement of the cap.

criteria.description: 借款基础将85%预付利率应用于符合条件的租赁净投资，但须扣除规定的扣除额或准备金。
criteria.grader_hint: 预付款率必须适用于合格金额，而不是应收账款总额或总账面资产。

original.criterion: The borrowing base applies the 85% advance rate to eligible lease net investment, subject to stated deductions or reserves.
original.grader_hint: The advance rate must apply to the eligible amount, not gross receivables or total booked assets.

criteria.description: 超额可用性或净空的计算方法为借款基础可用性减去未偿仓库债务，并且不会将负金额表示为可用借款。
criteria.grader_hint: 当义务超出可用性时，接受零可用性以及单独确定的缺陷。

original.criterion: Excess availability or headroom is calculated as borrowing-base availability less outstanding warehouse obligations and does not present a negative amount as available borrowing.
original.grader_hint: Accept zero availability plus a separately identified deficiency when obligations exceed availability.

criteria.description: 合格租赁净投资是使用可识别的租赁会计组成部分和适合每月重复应用的客观资格边界来定义的。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找租赁付款或应收账款、非劳动收入、剩余处理和排除之间的一致关系；拒绝循环定义，例如“管理层认为合格的金额”。

original.criterion: Eligible lease net investment is defined using recognizable lease-accounting components and an objective eligibility boundary suitable for repeatable monthly application.
original.grader_hint: Look for a coherent relationship among lease payments or receivables, unearned income, residual treatment, and exclusions; reject a circular definition such as 'amount management considers eligible.'

criteria.description: 资格定义排除或单独扣除拖欠、违约、有争议、欺诈、不可执行、冲销或以其他方式受损的租赁风险。
criteria.evidence: 合格租赁的定义和排除。
criteria.grader_hint: 为涵盖这些风险类别的专业连贯列表授予学分；不需要确切的措辞。

original.criterion: The eligibility definition excludes or separately deducts delinquent, defaulted, disputed, fraudulent, unenforceable, charged-off, or otherwise impaired lease exposures.
original.grader_hint: Award credit for a professionally coherent list covering these risk classes; exact wording is not required.

criteria.description: 该表格将重复融资、先前转让或产权负担以及不属于借款人所有的租赁视为不合格条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认该定义可防止相同的租赁价值支持多个融资索赔。

original.criterion: The form addresses duplicate funding, prior assignment or encumbrance, and leases not owned by the borrower as ineligible conditions.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the definition prevents the same lease value from supporting more than one financing claim.

criteria.description: 该文件将登记残值与承租人当前应收现金区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 残值定义、计算标签和分析师警告。
criteria.grader_hint: 这种区别必须是可操作的，而不仅仅是词汇句子；编制者不应将残值计入逾期承租人应收款中。

original.criterion: The document distinguishes booked residual value from cash currently due from a lessee.
original.evidence: Residual-value definition, calculation labels, and analyst warning.
original.grader_hint: The distinction must be operational, not merely a glossary sentence; a preparer should not be able to place residual value in past-due lessee receivables.

criteria.description: 该文件特意采用并披露了对合格租赁净投资内部或外部的入账残值的合理处理。
criteria.evidence: 定义时间表和借贷基础公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受具有明确会计和资格限制的纳入或单独/排除处理。选择、理由和计算效果必须是可见的。

original.criterion: The document deliberately adopts and discloses a defensible treatment of booked residual value within or outside eligible lease net investment.
original.grader_hint: Accept either inclusion with clear accounting and eligibility limits or separate/excluded treatment. The choice, rationale, and calculation effect must be visible.

criteria.description: 所选择的残值处理方法在合格金额、借款基础公式、拖欠分母和完成说明中一致应用。
criteria.evidence: 交叉检查文档中的定义和所有相关计算。
criteria.grader_hint: 在每次出现时追踪相同的组件，如果其中一个部分默默地恢复到先前的设施惯例，则扣留学分。

original.criterion: The chosen residual-value treatment is applied consistently in the eligible amount, borrowing-base formula, delinquency denominator, and completion instructions.
original.evidence: Cross-check of definitions and all related calculations within the document.
original.grader_hint: Trace the same component through each occurrence and withhold credit if one section silently reverts to the prior facility convention.

criteria.description: 拖欠率使用拖欠的合格租赁风险作为分子，并使用一致定义的合格租赁风险基础作为分母。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认分子和分母使用兼容的测量基准和日期。

original.criterion: The delinquency ratio uses delinquent eligible lease exposure in the numerator and a consistently defined eligible lease exposure base in the denominator.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that numerator and denominator use compatible measurement bases and dates.

criteria.description: 拖欠测试规定了最大允许比率5.0%。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较必须将5.0%视为上限，而不是自动遵从的触发点。

original.criterion: The delinquency test states a maximum permitted ratio of 5.0%.
original.grader_hint: The comparison must treat 5.0% as the ceiling, not the trigger for automatic compliance.

criteria.description: 拖欠与截至测试日期测量的客观账龄或逾期付款情况有关。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果明确且一致应用，作者选择的特定老化惯例是可以接受的；仅仅主观的收集关注是不够的。

original.criterion: Delinquency is tied to an objective aging or missed-payment condition measured as of the test date.
original.grader_hint: A specific aging convention chosen by the author is acceptable if clear and consistently applied; subjective collection concern alone is insufficient.

criteria.description: 该文件防止主要为了掩盖自动恢复资格的拖欠行为而进行的延期、重组、资本化或重新老化。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求实质性的反屏蔽控制，而不仅仅是账户重新分类后的精确算术。

original.criterion: The document prevents extensions, restructurings, capitalization, or re-aging undertaken primarily to conceal delinquency from automatically restoring eligibility.
original.grader_hint: Look for a substantive anti-masking control, not merely accurate arithmetic after the account has been reclassified.

criteria.description: 固定费用覆盖率的计算方法为调整后的 EBITDA 除以同一计量期间的固定费用。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认分子、分母和周期对齐。

original.criterion: Fixed-charge coverage is calculated as adjusted EBITDA divided by fixed charges for the same measurement period.
original.grader_hint: Confirm numerator, denominator, and period alignment.

criteria.description: 固定充电覆盖测试规定了1.20x 的最低要求。
criteria.grader_hint: 该表格必须清楚地表明，低于1.20x 的值在任何允许的固化之前都会失效。

original.criterion: The fixed-charge coverage test states a minimum requirement of 1.20x.
original.grader_hint: The form must clearly show that values below 1.20x fail before any permitted cure.

criteria.description: 调整后的 EBITDA 从定义的会计利润指标开始，并使用一组有限的、可审查的调整类别。
criteria.evidence: 调整后的 EBITDA 定义和计算时间表。
criteria.grader_hint: 授予学分，其中起点和每个允许的类别都是可识别的；开放式的管理自由裁量权还不够。

original.criterion: Adjusted EBITDA begins from a defined accounting profit measure and uses a finite, reviewable set of adjustment categories.
original.evidence: Adjusted EBITDA definition and calculation schedule.
original.grader_hint: Award credit where the starting point and each permitted class are identifiable; open-ended management discretion is not sufficient.

criteria.description: 每个 EBITDA 回加必须单独描述、量化、支持、批准或审查，而不是作为未解释的总计输入。
criteria.evidence: 添加回时间表和完成说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 该表格可以提供空白行，但必须需要证据并防止无支持的一次性调整。

original.criterion: Each EBITDA add-back must be separately described, quantified, supported, and approved or reviewed rather than entered as an unexplained aggregate.
original.grader_hint: The form may provide blank rows, but it must require evidence and prevent unsupported lump-sum adjustments.

criteria.description: 预计的节省、协同效应以及可自由支配的或经常性的运营成本不会自动被视为 EBITDA 返还。
criteria.evidence: 回加定义和编制者指南。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件应该排除这些类别，或者让它们遵守明确的、可支持的契约标准，而不是接受管理标签。

original.criterion: Projected savings, synergies, and discretionary or recurring operating costs are not automatically treated as EBITDA add-backs.
original.grader_hint: The document should either exclude these categories or subject them to explicit, supportable covenant criteria rather than accepting management labels.

criteria.description: 该文件明确将契约调整后的 EBITDA 与董事会衡量指标进行了协调，而不是宣布这两种衡量指标相同。
criteria.evidence: 调节要求、定义或完成注释。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一个桥梁，表明董事会报告是需要审查的输入，而不是控制契约措施。

original.criterion: The document explicitly reconciles covenant adjusted EBITDA to the board-pack measure instead of declaring the two measures identical.
original.evidence: Reconciliation requirement, definition, or completion note.
original.grader_hint: Look for a bridge showing that board reporting is an input requiring review, not the controlling covenant measure.

criteria.description: 固定费用的定义是为了捕获与偿债能力相关的经常性现金义务，包括利息和预定本金或等值融资付款。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受一致的专业定义，该定义还涉及租赁或类似的固定融资付款（如果适用）。

original.criterion: Fixed charges are defined to capture the recurring cash obligations relevant to debt-service capacity, including interest and scheduled principal or equivalent financing payments.
original.grader_hint: Accept a coherent professional definition that also addresses lease or similar fixed financing payments where applicable.

criteria.description: EBITDA 和固定费用定义避免了在回加和分母调整中重复计算同一项目。
criteria.grader_hint: 通过比率两侧追踪利息、租赁费用和非现金费用等常见项目。

original.criterion: The EBITDA and fixed-charge definitions avoid double counting the same item in both an add-back and a denominator adjustment.
original.grader_hint: Trace common items such as interest, lease expense, and non-cash charges through both sides of the ratio.

criteria.description: 股权补救条款规定，补救措施仅适用于固定费用承保契约。
criteria.evidence: 股权治愈定义和状态说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认修复收益不能用于修复借贷基础或拖欠失败。

original.criterion: The equity-cure provision states that a cure applies only to the fixed-charge coverage covenant.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that cure proceeds cannot be used to fix borrowing-base or delinquency failures.

criteria.description: 证书日期和状态机制保留完整的10工作日产后治愈窗口。
criteria.evidence: 交付日期、治愈期限和认证状态字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 在规定的修复期生效之前，该表格不应要求提供不合格的无违约证明。预固化失败或待固化指定是可以接受的。

original.criterion: Certificate dating and status mechanics preserve the full 10-business-day post-delivery cure window.
original.evidence: Delivery date, cure deadline, and certification status fields.
original.grader_hint: The form should not require an unqualified no-default certification before the stated cure period can operate. A pre-cure failure or cure-pending designation is acceptable.

criteria.description: 股权修复条款记录了在任何滚动的四个季度期间不得超过两次使用的限制。
criteria.evidence: 股权治愈定义或使用跟踪器。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件必须使滚动回顾可操作，例如要求确定上一季度的使用情况。

original.criterion: The equity-cure provision records the limit of no more than two uses in any rolling four-quarter period.
original.grader_hint: The document must make the rolling lookback operational, such as by requiring prior-quarter usage to be identified.

criteria.description: 除非输入并支持捐款金额和资助日期，否则治疗无法记录为已完成。
criteria.grader_hint: 空白的假设治疗或管理意图不得产生治疗后合规状态。

original.criterion: A cure cannot be recorded as completed unless the contribution amount and funding date are entered and supported.
original.grader_hint: A blank hypothetical cure or management intention must not produce a post-cure compliant status.

criteria.description: 该表格分别显示了预固化覆盖结果和任何允许的后固化结果。
criteria.evidence: 固定费用覆盖范围计算。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认读者可以看到治疗前的实际结果和资助治疗后的调整结果。

original.criterion: The form separately presents the pre-cure coverage result and any permitted post-cure result.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that a reader can see the actual result before cure and the adjusted result after funded cure.

criteria.description: 根据基本情景展望，合格租赁净投资预计每月将比上个月连续下降2%。
criteria.evidence: 一月至三月的展望和公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受与用户输入的 12 月金额相关的公式或解释性计算。二月必须是一月的98%和三月的98%，在±0.1%之内。

original.criterion: Under the base-case outlook, eligible lease net investment is projected to decline by 2% successively each month from the preceding month's amount.
original.grader_hint: Accept formulas or explanatory calculations anchored to a user-entered December amount. February must be 98% of January and March 98% of February, within ±0.1%.

criteria.description: 基本情况预计固定费用覆盖范围等于 $1.80 百万除以 $1.35 百万，或约为 1.33x。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受±0.01x 范围内的1.33x 以及符合1.20x 最小值的合规标签。

original.criterion: The base-case projected fixed-charge coverage equals $1.80 million divided by $1.35 million, or approximately 1.33x.
original.grader_hint: Accept 1.33x within ±0.01x and a compliant label against the 1.20x minimum.

criteria.description: 下行拖欠路径显示一月为4.8%，二月为5.4%，三月为6.0%。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受 ±0.1 个百分点内的每个预计比率。

original.criterion: The downside delinquency path shows 4.8% in January, 5.4% in February, and 6.0% in March.
original.grader_hint: Accept each projected ratio within ±0.1 percentage points.

criteria.description: 下行前景将一月确定为5.0%限制之内，二月为预计高于限制的第一个月份。
criteria.evidence: 下行前景状态标签或评论。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据预计路径检查状态，而不是接受一般警告。

original.criterion: The downside outlook identifies January as within the 5.0% limit and February as the first projected month above the limit.
original.evidence: Downside outlook status labels or commentary.
original.grader_hint: Check the status against the projected path rather than accepting a generic warning.

criteria.description: 前景被明确标记为预测或情景，并且不包含在首席执行官对实际期末合规性的认证中。
criteria.evidence: Outlook 标题、警告、签名范围和证明措辞。
criteria.grader_hint: 理性的读者不应将预计的 1 月至 3 月结果误认为是经过认证的实际结果。

original.criterion: The outlook is clearly labeled as a forecast or scenario and is not included within the CEO's certification of actual period-end compliance.
original.evidence: Outlook heading, caveat, signature scope, and certification wording.
original.grader_hint: A reasonable reader must not mistake projected January–March outcomes for certified actual results.

criteria.description: 展望再现了所提供的假设，并将未指定的余额或治疗收益留为空白或由公式驱动，而不是发明它们。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查是否存在捏造的 12 月余额、未偿债务、客户数据或作为事实呈现的假设股权出资。

original.criterion: The outlook reproduces the supplied assumptions and leaves unspecified balances or cure proceeds blank or formula-driven rather than inventing them.
original.grader_hint: Inspect for fabricated December balances, outstanding debt, customer data, or hypothetical equity contributions presented as facts.

criteria.description: 该文件要求源系统或分类账支持、计算证据和审阅者签字与每个月度证书一起保留。
criteria.grader_hint: 电子保留是可以接受的。该说明应涵盖源余额和调整。

original.criterion: The document requires source-system or ledger support, calculation evidence, and reviewer sign-off to be retained with each monthly certificate.
original.grader_hint: Electronic retention is acceptable. The instruction should cover both source balances and adjustments.

criteria.description: 每月流程在首席执行官签名之前分配不同的准备者和审阅者证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 姓名、缩写、日期或同等受控证据是可接受的； CEO 签名本身并不能代替计算审核。

original.criterion: The monthly process assigns distinct preparer and reviewer evidence before CEO signature.
original.grader_hint: Names, initials, dates, or equivalent controlled evidence are acceptable; the CEO signature alone is not a substitute for calculation review.

criteria.description: 完成指南告诉首次分析人员要填充什么、要获取什么证据、如何处理空白或不可用的值以及何时升级异常。
criteria.evidence: 嵌入式说明和字段标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 作为第一天分析师查看表格。只有在不询问作者基本流程问题的情况下即可完成的情况下才授予学分。

original.criterion: Completion guidance tells a first-time analyst what to populate, what evidence to obtain, how to handle blanks or unavailable values, and when to escalate an exception.
original.grader_hint: Review the form as a day-one analyst. Award credit only if it can be completed without asking the author basic process questions.

criteria.description: 只要满足多个约定，定义就使用相同的命名术语、测量日期和周期约定。
criteria.evidence: 证书计算和定义时间表。
criteria.grader_hint: 通过该文件至少追踪合格租赁、合格租赁净投资、拖欠率、调整后 EBITDA、固定费用和股本治愈率。

original.criterion: Definitions use the same named terms, measurement dates, and period conventions wherever they feed more than one covenant.
original.grader_hint: Trace at least Eligible Lease, Eligible Lease Net Investment, Delinquency Ratio, Adjusted EBITDA, Fixed Charges, and Equity Cure through the document.

criteria.description: 该文件被确定为先前设施样板的受控替换，并记录残值处理和相关定义的变化。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找版本或生效日期控制以及简洁的实质性变更描述；通用的“新模板”声明是不够的。

original.criterion: The document is identified as the controlled replacement for the prior facility boilerplate and records that residual-value treatment and related definitions changed.
original.grader_hint: Look for a version or effective-date control plus a concise substantive change description; a generic 'new template' statement is insufficient.

criteria.description: 该证书仅请求计算契约所需的信息，并避免提供银行账户详细信息或不必要的承租人级别的个人数据，从而最大限度地减少敏感内容。
criteria.evidence: 所有表单字段和时间表。
criteria.grader_hint: 汇总的财务数据和内部支持参考是适当的；详细的支付凭证或不相关的个​​人标识符则不然。

original.criterion: The certificate minimizes sensitive content by requesting only information needed for covenant calculations and avoiding bank-account details or unnecessary lessee-level personal data.
original.grader_hint: Aggregated financial data and internal support references are appropriate; detailed payment credentials or unrelated personal identifiers are not.

criteria.description: 该文件对于计算、认证、例外情况和所需证据具体且明确，同时避免了不受支持的法律结论。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估专家是否能够在不依赖模糊样板的情况下区分事实认证、计算合规性、预测信息和解释选择。

original.criterion: The document is specific and unambiguous about calculations, certifications, exceptions, and required evidence while avoiding unsupported legal conclusions.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether a specialist can distinguish factual certification, calculated compliance, forecast information, and interpretation choices without relying on vague boilerplate.

criteria.description: 渲染的文档具有专业用途：计算和定义清晰，相关字段可遵循，签名或输入区域不会被剪裁或过度拥挤。
criteria.grader_hint: 以正常阅读尺寸查看所有页面。轻微的外观变化是可以接受的，但密集的格式不得影响完成或审查。

original.criterion: The rendered document is professionally usable: calculations and definitions are legible, related fields can be followed, and signature or entry areas are not clipped or overcrowded.
original.grader_hint: Review all pages at normal reading size. Minor cosmetic variation is acceptable, but dense formatting must not compromise completion or review.

review.selection: 沿用旧review-500中南杨c0–c3固定随机100题，未重抽、未挑题。

validation_record.label: 结构/材料验收记录
validation_record.detail: validated 属于结构、防泄漏、材料推进验收；没有内容正确率结论。

author_policy_self_report_not_verified.reviewer_policy: A finance-domain reviewer should render the document, trace each defined term through the certificate, independently recompute the forecast figures, and assess whether the chosen residual treatment is defensible and consistently disclosed. Either of the two defensible residual-value treatments receives full credit when its consequences are explicit.
known_limitations: No executed credit agreement or lender form is supplied, so the artifact must not imply that borrower-drafted definitions have been legally accepted by the lender.
The task permits more than one defensible residual-value treatment; grading focuses on accounting coherence, disclosure, and internal consistency rather than a single mandated choice.
Monthly balances are intentionally unavailable, so the reusable certificate must retain blank or input fields instead of presenting a completed December factual certification.

not_claimed: 不是本轮agent独立内容复审通过
不是正式正确率或RewardKit验收
不是证明此批质量排名第一

gold_policy_self_report_not_verified.reviewer_policy: A finance-domain reviewer should render the document, trace each defined term through the certificate, independently recompute the forecast figures, and assess whether the chosen residual treatment is defensible and consistently disclosed. Either of the two defensible residual-value treatments receives full credit when its consequences are explicit.
known_limitations: No executed credit agreement or lender form is supplied, so the artifact must not imply that borrower-drafted definitions have been legally accepted by the lender.
The task permits more than one defensible residual-value treatment; grading focuses on accounting coherence, disclosure, and internal consistency rather than a single mandated choice.
Monthly balances are intentionally unavailable, so the reusable certificate must retain blank or input fields instead of presenting a completed December factual certification.

spec.professional_context: A finance manager is establishing the first controlled monthly covenant process for a newly closed warehouse facility. The form will be completed by finance staff, reviewed by a specialist, and signed by the CEO, so definitional ambiguity could create recurring false certifications.
difficulty_sources: Selecting and disclosing a defensible residual-value treatment while preserving accounting and covenant consistency.
Reconciling a commercially promised board EBITDA measure with supportable covenant adjustments.
Designing certificate dating and statuses that preserve a post-delivery equity-cure window without premature certification.
Making one compact controlled document both signature-ready and usable by a first-time preparer.
Separating projected covenant outcomes from actual-period certification.

authoring_plan.artifact_intent: Construct a concise controlled Word form that combines a reusable monthly compliance certificate, definitions that drive its formulas, practical completion guidance for a new analyst, and a separately labeled forward outlook. The signed attestation must cover completed actual-period information only.
imperfections_and_tensions_to_preserve: The prior facility convention treated booked residual value like current lessee receivables, while the ledger records residuals separately.
A commercial stakeholder informally promised that covenant EBITDA would be the same as a board reporting measure containing discretionary adjustments.
The borrower must draft definitions without an executed definitions schedule, making both inclusion of bounded residual value and separate treatment defensible if clearly selected.
The certificate is due before the equity-cure window expires, so the form needs a truthful pre-cure or cure-pending state rather than an unqualified premature compliance assertion.
No actual monthly balances, obligor records, cure proceeds, or add-back evidence exist and none may be fabricated.
gold_relationships: Borrowing-base availability equals the lesser of 85% of eligible lease net investment after applicable deductions or reserves and the $25 million facility cap.
Headroom equals borrowing-base availability less outstanding warehouse obligations; a shortfall is disclosed separately rather than shown as negative borrowing availability.
The chosen residual treatment must use ledger-consistent components and must propagate identically through eligible lease net investment, the borrowing base, and the delinquency denominator.
Residual value is not a currently due lessee payment and must not enter past-due receivables merely because it is booked as an asset.
The delinquency ratio uses delinquent eligible exposure over a consistently measured eligible exposure base as of the same test date, with 5.0% as the maximum.
Fixed-charge coverage equals adjusted EBITDA divided by fixed charges for the same period, with 1.20x as the minimum.

Covenant EBITDA starts from an accounting profit measure and includes only separately identified, quantified, evidenced, reviewable adjustments; it is reconciled to rather than equated with the board measure.
Equity cure applies only to fixed-charge coverage, can be recognized only after actual funding, remains subject to the rolling usage limit, and preserves both pre-cure and post-cure results.
The delivery deadline equals 15 business days after month-end, while the cure deadline equals 10 business days after delivery.
Base-case coverage equals 1.80 divided by 1.35, approximately 1.33x.
Base-case eligible lease net investment compounds downward by 2% each month from a blank December input.
Downside delinquency progresses from 4.2% in December to 4.8% in January, 5.4% in February, and 6.0% in March; February is the first projected breach of a 5.0% ceiling.
required_vocabulary_and_controls: The document itself must carry the locally supplied party names, facility amount, thresholds, deadlines, cure scope, and cure-frequency limit.

Use clear defined concepts for Eligible Lease, Eligible Lease Net Investment, Booked Residual Value, Delinquency Ratio, Adjusted EBITDA, Fixed Charges, Borrowing Base, Availability, and Equity Cure, although minor naming variations are acceptable if cross-references remain exact.
Provide explicit actual-period covenant statuses and distinguish compliant, non-compliant, and cure-pending conditions.
Require preparer evidence, independent reviewer evidence, CEO execution, support retention, exception disclosure, and controlled-form version information.
Record that the new controlled form replaces prior facility boilerplate and specifically changes residual-value handling and related definitions.

behaviour_specification.intended_verdict: A strong solution is signature-ready after monthly inputs and review, prevents the known residual-value misuse, reconciles rather than blindly adopts board EBITDA, preserves the cure window, and teaches a new analyst how to complete the control without claiming invented facts.
behaviour_specification.acceptable_residual_reading_a: Include a defined and bounded booked residual component in eligible lease net investment when supported by the selected accounting rationale, while keeping it separate from currently due lessee payments and applying appropriate eligibility limitations.
behaviour_specification.acceptable_residual_reading_b: Exclude or separately report booked residual value from eligible lease net investment and the advance base, with the same exclusion reflected in related denominator definitions.
unacceptable_behaviours: Treating booked residual as cash presently due from a lessee.
Declaring board-pack EBITDA automatically equal to covenant adjusted EBITDA.
Using hypothetical or unfunded cure proceeds to label the certificate compliant.
Allowing an equity cure to fix borrowing-base or delinquency failures.
Presenting the forward outlook as part of the CEO's certification of actual compliance.
Inventing actual balances, lessee details, discretionary add-backs, or cure contributions.

authoring_plan.offline_feasibility_review: An imagined reference solution can be authored with python-docx or a standard office suite, rendered offline, and checked by tracing definitions and recomputing the supplied scenario arithmetic. All rubric evidence is available within the single submitted document.

original_instruction:
You are Petra Beaulieu, the financial manager at Cinderhall Utilities, and you are turning the newly closed $25 million warehouse facility from Sunderly Collective into a monthly control that a finance analyst who has never prepared a lender certificate can complete without coming back to you. Jelena Hendricks signs the certificate as CEO, beginning with the December test date, and it is due 15 business days after each month-end. The commercial terms set an 85% advance rate on eligible lease net investment, availability capped at the lower of that borrowing base and $25 million, minimum fixed-charge coverage of 1.20x, and a delinquency limit of 5.0%. An equity cure may be funded during the 10 business days after delivery, applies only to fixed-charge coverage, and may be used no more than twice in any rolling four-quarter period. Prepare `warehouse_compliance_certificate.docx`, containing the reusable certificate and its definitions schedule, ready for controlled monthly use and signature. Keep the complete document to eight pages. The deal team did not settle whether booked residual value belongs within eligible lease net investment or should be shown separately, and either defensible reading is acceptable if the form makes the choice and its effect unmistakable. That matters because residuals are recorded separately in Cinderhall’s ledger, while the previous facility’s boilerplate treated them as current lease receivables. Arjun Gauthier has also been telling Sunderly that the certificate will use “the same EBITDA as the board pack,” although the board measure includes discretionary adjustments that may not belong in a covenant calculation. Analysts have previously treated booked residual as cash currently due from a lessee; the new form must prevent that misuse rather than quietly perpetuate it. Include a clearly non-certifying outlook for January through March: under the base case, eligible lease net investment declines 2% each month, quarterly adjusted EBITDA is $1.80 million, and fixed charges are $1.35 million; under the downside case, delinquency starts at 4.2% in December and rises by 0.6 percentage points each month. Do not invent balances, obligor details, cure proceeds, or discretionary add-backs. Make this the controlled form replacing the prior facility boilerplate and identify what changed. Write the file into the top level of the working directory using exactly the filename given.
